runtime.execution: Stage manager drives ProcessPoolExecutor candidate search; each worker drafts/debugs/improves code and uses resettable multiprocessing interpreter; later plotting/writeup/review calls.
runtime.service_boundary: Owns experiment process workspaces, tree journals/checkpoints and local GPU assignment; consumes model providers. Not a shared computation-service consumer interface.

summary: Branching experiment-code search with hyperparameter/ablation/multi-seed stages and model interpretation of measured outputs.

inspection.scope: launcher, manager stage loop/checkpoint, node worker dispatch/code execution/provider adaptation, result/metric parsing, summary and protocol assertions
inspection.limits: No first-party tests found in source inventory. Runtime assertions are inspected but unexecuted; full plotting/writeup/idea-generation internals were not exhaustively traced. No models/code/GPU ran.

actions.name: AgentManager.run / ParallelAgent.step
actions.output: Candidate journals, stage transitions/checkpoints and results.
actions.lifecycle: Stage/substage loop; process-pool parallel candidates and seed evaluation after completion.
actions.authority: Operator config/model budgets; not live user-authored turn graph.

actions.name: _draft / _debug / _improve / hyperparameter / ablation / seed node
actions.input: Parent node, task stage and generated specific experiment idea.
actions.output: Node with plan/code, parent identity, measurements and feedback.
actions.lifecycle: Worker-local generation followed by reset interpreter execution.
actions.authority: Model controls candidate code; host chooses branch/action and GPU assignment.

actions.name: Interpreter.run / cleanup_session
actions.lifecycle: Normal search resets each run; optional reuse has timeout limitation; direct TERM/KILL cleanup.
actions.authority: Host child OS authority; ready/finished assertions are protocol checks.

actions.name: parse_exec_result / metrics parser / paper review
actions.input: Code/results, generated numpy data and review FunctionSpec/PDF.
actions.output: Bug/metric summary and stored review text/image reports.
actions.lifecycle: Metrics parser is generated and executed, then model interprets values; final review separate from candidate execution.
actions.authority: Configured evaluator model, no fixed independent correctness oracle.

filesystem.detail: Per-worker workspaces save generated program/data/plots; journals and idea/checkpoint files capture candidates. Shared scientific provenance for arbitrary external IO is not supplied.

processes.detail: Process-pool node workers own reset interpreter children; timeout logs at future boundary, direct interpreter cleanup cannot prove whole descendant-tree quiescence and GPU bookkeeping is released even after wait timeout.

code_actions.detail: Model generates complete candidate plan/code; parent determines draft/debug/improve/hyperparameter/ablation action and executes fresh candidate. No model-native arbitrary shell/schema dispatch engine is implied.

persistent_kernel.detail: Interpreter can reuse global_scope with reset_session=False, but actual search calls True then cleanup. Timeout asserts reset mode, so optional interactive namespace is not the normal search or shared standing kernel contract.

standing_database.detail: Not established in the explicitly inspected launcher, manager stage loop/checkpoint, node worker dispatch/code execution/provider adaptation, result/metric parsing, summary and protocol assertions; no universal absence claim.

workflow_programming.detail: Model-generated scientific substages and candidate programs run within fixed stage/search manager, callbacks and budgets. This is research-plan flexibility rather than hot arbitrary turn-program redefinition.

multi_model.detail: Separate configured code/feedback/summary and paper-review models plus provider adaptation are explicit. These are distinct pipeline roles, not live peer room.

live_collaboration.detail: Branch workers consume parent/journal summaries and aggregate results; inspected search supplies no addressed live peer messaging.

concurrent_work.detail: Process-pool futures evaluate candidates concurrently, with local GPU allocation and sequential collection. Model/worker timeout semantics and actual cancellation differ.

steering_interrupt.detail: Interpreter timeout sends SIGINT then direct process cleanup; future wait timeout only logs in inspected step. No general operator/provider live steering contract is established.

turn_redefinition.detail: Not established in the explicitly inspected launcher, manager stage loop/checkpoint, node worker dispatch/code execution/provider adaptation, result/metric parsing, summary and protocol assertions; no universal absence claim.

compaction.detail: Node stdout projection truncates and journal summary supplies reduced scientific history to workers. These are task-memory projections, not raw-archived conversation transformations.

context_repair.detail: Debugging repairs experiment code from output/ancestry; no recovery of original omitted/corrupted conversational context is traced.

original_audit.detail: Candidate tree retains code/results/ancestry/UUID/time plus checkpoint and delivered review files. Query wrapper discards provider metadata and stdout is projected/truncated; no complete original wire/OS/action audit.

audit_query.detail: Journal node identities/parents support result lookup/selection and projection to report; no generic immutable audit query service is established.

hot_change.detail: Candidate/plot/metric code is generated and run during search; this changes research programs, not resident harness code or live stage-engine implementation.

rebuild_continuity.detail: Tree/phase/config checkpoint is partial task state; no active worker/model-stack continuity or harness executable refit is established.

remote_services.detail: OpenAI/Anthropic backend requests are consumed with role models; experiment computation is owned local process/GPU execution in inspected main path.

self_improvement.detail: Draft/debug/improve/hyperparameter/ablation/multi-seed candidate loop is an autoresearch pattern over experiment code. It does not improve its own harness, and metrics/evaluation parsing are model-generated.

complaints.detail: Not established in the explicitly inspected launcher, manager stage loop/checkpoint, node worker dispatch/code execution/provider adaptation, result/metric parsing, summary and protocol assertions; no universal absence claim.

authority.detail: Generated code executes with worker host OS authority in process workdir; no true isolation or command approval gate occurs in traced interpreter. Function schemas constrain result shape, not code effects.

evaluation.detail: Actual experiment/metric-parsing programs run, seed evaluation reuses parent parser, and model feedback marks bugs/metrics. This is stronger than pure review prose but evaluator/parser can share model errors; final paper reviewer is artifact assessment, not independent test suite.

time_order.detail: Node UUID/parent/step/time and ready/finished/EOF protocol express local search order. No exact-generation owner ticket or append-only global causal event audit appears.

evidence.claim: Launcher preserves idea JSON, edits experiment config and invokes BFTS search before copying experiment results.
Stage/substage loop creates agents, runs steps and transitions based on stage completion, then multi-seed evaluation of best node.
Model produces plan+code with repair feedback on extraction; result feedback model sees code/output, marks buggy from model flag or actual exception.
Worker creates process-specific workspace/MinimalAgent/Interpreter and GPU environment assignment.
Node dispatch selects debug/hyperparameter/ablation/improve, runs generated child code with reset_session=True and cleans interpreter.
Node selection serializes parents and optionally generates journal memory summary for child prompts.
Process-pool futures return node records into journal; timeout logs but finally releases local GPU assignment without cancelling future here.
Interpreter child executes code against global_scope and writes ready/finished/EOF, with traceback and KeyboardInterrupt relabeled TimeoutError.
run defaults to reset_session=True; optional False reuses process only after first spawn; cleanup TERM/KILL targets direct child.
Protocol asserts ready/finished states; timeout asserts reset mode, repeatedly sends SIGINT then direct-child cleanup after grace.
UUID/time/parent node stores plan/code, execution output/exception/metrics/plots and feedback.
Node projection absorbs execution facts; term_out property truncates stored stdout for prompts.
Stage checkpoint overwrites pickle containing journals/history/config/current stage; not ongoing process stack.
Query compiles prompt and picks OpenAI/Anthropic backend/model-specific request options; returns output only.
SDK request forces selected function spec; asserts function name/presence then parses JSON, with usage/metadata returned to backend wrapper.
Model writes metrics parsing code against generated numpy artifacts; that code runs and another structured model response interprets printed metrics.
Optional final paper/text/image review reads PDF and writes reviewer outputs; not a completion gate for earlier experiment executions.

tests.focus: Runtime protocol assertion and unsupported interactive timeout
tests.oracle: These are runtime assertions, not a test suite: ready/finished tuple labels and reset_session-on-timeout are asserted. They catch protocol misuse but no independent process-tree or scientific oracle is supplied; unexecuted.
Runtime assertions require function call presence/name and JSON parse. They check shape only, not source truth, metric extraction accuracy or researcher/reviewer independence; unexecuted.

strengths: Explicit candidate ancestry and separate draft/debug/improve/ablation/seed evaluation stages.
Measures actual generated-program outputs rather than only grading paper prose.
limits: Generation and evaluation/parser model errors can correlate; no independent suite found.
Future timeout is not worker cancellation, direct-child cleanup is not descendant quiescence.
Search normal path resets kernels; checkpoints do not preserve provider/process continuity.
arconaut_questions: Can autodroit reuse this candidate tree while requiring immutable evaluator/oracle outside the candidate control?
What exact authority/work identity must be held until timed-out compute actually stops?
